env_allowlist.PATH: runner-provided helper discovery; Lean, Lake, and Bubblewrap identities are checked
env_allowlist.HOME: runner-provided only for pinned Lake/Elan discovery; the Lean sandbox uses a temporary HOME

network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs at trust zero in Bubblewrap with an unshared network, a read-only host root, a writable disposable module directory, fixed locale and timezone, umask 022, and one Lean thread. Existing pinned compiled dependencies are reused read-only, so this is warm nonrelease evidence rather than a cold hermetic release replay.
status_boundary: The recipe validates the frozen statement, conditional root composition, seven partial proof declarations, and four separately written geometric/composition probes. The derivative-small Palais-Smale sequence, unconditional critical package, and exact root remain unproved. Complete trust/provenance, cold hermetic replay, and distinct-runner verification are not claimed.
